reviews.text:
After falling in love with the cleansing oil from SKINFOOD, I was so excited to try their Daily Brightening Rice Scrub Foam. I had high expectations because of how great their products are, and this one did not disappoint.

The scrub foam has a really nice, gentle texture with tiny rice particles that give you a mild exfoliation. When you add water, it creates a rich foam that cleanses your skin deeply, while the scrub particles work to gently remove dead skin cells without feeling rough or harsh.

What I love most is the feeling of freshness and brightness it leaves on my skin after using it. It's the perfect second step after the cleansing oil. I'm so happy with this product and can't wait to see the results with continued use.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意 SKINFOOD 嘅潔面油之後，好興奮試吓佢哋嘅 Daily Brightening Rice Scrub Foam。因為佢哋嘅產品一向都好好，所以我期望好高，而呢款冇令我失望。

磨砂泡沫質地好好、好溫和，有細細粒嘅米粒，提供輕微去角質效果。加水之後會打出豐富嘅泡沫，深層清潔皮膚，而磨砂顆粒亦會溫和咁去除死皮，唔會感覺粗糙或者猛烈。

我最鍾意用完之後皮膚感覺清新、明亮。係潔面油之後嘅完美第二步。我好開心呢款產品，等不及繼續用，睇吓效果。

reviews.text: I’ve been really impressed with the quality of these skincare products! The textures are lightweight yet hydrating, and my skin feels noticeably smoother and more balanced. I especially love how gentle the formulas are—no irritation or breakouts, just a healthy glow. The packaging is also really clean and convenient. Definitely a brand I’ll keep coming back to!

reviews.text: I’m really impressed with the SKINFOOD Rice Daily Brightening Scrub Foam! It has a gentle yet effective formula that exfoliates without being harsh. My skin feels smooth and looks brighter after each use. The rice particles are just the right size for a refreshing scrub, and it leaves my face feeling clean and radiant. Definitely a must-have in my daily routine!

reviews.zh: 呢個係我最愛嘅產品，用完真係睇到分別同好處。超級補濕、舒緩、安撫，減少咗我嘅痘印同色素沉澱，令皮膚超級有光澤。我係混合、敏感、易長痘嘅皮膚，佢真係幫咗我好多，改善咗鼻同唇周圍嘅泛紅，亦都收細咗毛孔。所以我極力推薦俾所有人，呢個係我用過最好嘅產品。所以我推薦俾所有想補濕、有痘印同色素沉澱嘅人，佢會幫到你好多，我肯定係最好嘅潔面產品！對皺紋同泛紅都好有效，如果你皮膚敏感，好似我咁，佢超級補濕、舒緩，我真係好推薦你試吓。

reviews.text: I know that physically exfoliating often is kinda bad for your skin, but this scrub is pretty gentle, and it makes my face feel so smooth and refreshed. The grains are smooth and small, and don't feel irritating at all. If you get a lot of build up throughout the day, it's great at clearing it out. I even use it as an exfoliator before shaving underarms and legs. I have bought this product three times now! (on various platforms)
reviews.zh: 我知道物理去角質通常對皮膚唔太好，但呢款磨砂都幾溫和，令我張面感覺好滑、好清新。顆粒細滑，完全唔會覺得刺激。如果一日累積咗好多污垢，佢都幾好清走。我仲會喺剃腋下同腳之前用佢去角質。我已經買咗三次（喺唔同平台買）！

reviews.text:
In the morning my skin tends to be pretty dry as I typically deep cleanse the night before, especially if I went out and wore makeup. With this being said, a mild cleanser such as this one is really soothing as it it contains small beads that mildly exfoliate the areas of my face that are prone to collecting more sebum (typically my T-Zone is more oily), whilst ensuring my skin isn't completely stripped of its natural oils so I don't end up with dried up skin. This is quite relieving as washing my face twice a day had always been a tedious venture with my previous harsh cleansers, which tended to make my skin more sensitive to other skincare products and provide adverse reactions. I can't say that I face the same problem while using this rice cleanser.

--Also another bonus is that a little goes a long way; I've had this for over a YEAR, and despite my daily usage, it still has a significant amount in the tube to spare!
reviews.zh:
朝早嗰陣我皮膚通常都幾乾，因為我前一晚會深層潔面，尤其係如果我出過街、化過妝嗰晚。話咁講，呢款咁溫和嘅潔面產品真係好舒緩，因為佢含有細細粒嘅顆粒，可以溫和咁去角質，針對容易積聚皮脂嘅位置（我嘅 T 區通常比較油），同時確保我嘅皮膚唔會完全失去天然油脂，唔會變得乾身。呢點好安心，因為以前我每日洗面兩次都係一件好麻煩嘅事，之前嗰啲刺激嘅潔面產品，令我皮膚對其他護膚品更加敏感，亦會有不良反應。用呢款米潔面，我就冇面對同樣嘅問題。

--另外一個好處係，一少少已經好夠用；我用咗一年多，儘管每日都用，支裝入面仲有好多剩低！
